items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Because I remember Chris White liked Warner and Rubio playing.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, uh, I came up with Chris White, the bass player from Dizzy's. That's right. Okay. And Rublo was playing Dying Job. Mm-hmm. And, let's see, Joe Bentley. That would be it, unless it was a trombone. I don't think it was any trombone, no. Warner. Warner, that's right, yeah. Because I remember Chris White liked Warner and Rubio playing. That's right. And then March the 2nd, the parade at the Corner Club. You were there. Mm-hmm. I got notes on that, I guess. That would have been Anderson's band, Anderson…
That's right. Because you remember you asked me, who were some of those fellas, say you didn't know them, are they in the union? Yeah.
